answer: About 36%: 63 of 175 miRNAs show significant differential expression between patient and control groups before multiple-testing correction (two-sided Welch t-test on the raw Ct values, uncorrected p<0.05). Sensitivity to the test choice: 38.3% (Student two-sided t-test), 33.7% (Wilcoxon/Mann-Whitney) — so the order of magnitude is stable (~34–38%).

payload.primary_test: Welch two-sided t-test on raw Ct
